verdict.rationale: Community Phone is a business phone service, so a contact-centric, team-shared communication history is a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence never documents calls and texts threaded under a contact, contact notes, or a history the whole team can see. What it does show is adjacent: texting through the dashboard, call activity history, and sharing a business number with a team. None of that is the shared contact timeline with notes the story asks for.

support.subject: As a sales lead, calls and texts thread under a contact with notes and history the whole team sees
